Full signed reciprocal physical |G|<=12 bohr^-1 is explicit rather than inferred from saved density rows. Existing qe_ionic_ewald real/reciprocal/self/background scalar and derivative are used without modification.
sum_contract.scope: One finite scalar only, fixed cell/alpha/cutoffs with derivative off real cutoff crossing surfaces. Real cutoff crossing rejection and cutoff-gap diagnostic retain the passing primitive semantics. No convergence certificate, automatic cutoff tightening, additional scalar refinement, repeated application or compensation is implemented.
sum_contract.native_distinction: QE native energy and force independently choose different finite sums. Native ion-ion force is F14.8 rounded. Comparing this scalar derivative to its ion-ion block does not assert native-energy derivative identity, total-force reproduction or a new PBE stationary state.
sum_contract.no_repair: No net-force subtraction, symmetry projection, force cancellation fit, support selection or displaced-Ewald curvature is added. Only the returned linear ionic force can enter PreparedReference with its admitted fixed joint C.
